_README: Template for episodes/<SYM>.json — the filing-read facts for one Sunday episode.
Delete every _README and _HOWTO key before building.
RULE ZERO: at least three original findings or the build fails.
Every figure names the source id it came from. Every source id resolves in `sources`.
_HOWTO_sources: One entry per filing you cite. `label` is what renders in SOURCES.md; `url` is the EDGAR archive folder. Source ids are referenced by every figure's `src`.
_HOWTO_filings: Every figure read out of a filing. `v` = the value, `src` = a source id, `unit` = what it is. validate_facts.py re-finds each one in the filing text on a NUMBER BOUNDARY — add `_pct` or `searchAs` if a figure appears differently in the text; never loosen the match. Mark anything you recomputed across many filings `_derived`.

filings._vendorNote: Optional. If crosscheck.py disagrees with the filings, explain exactly why here and state that the filings win.

insider._HOWTO: No single Form 4 states an aggregate. Cache the XML under .cache_form4/<SYM>/ and let the audit re-parse and recompute it.

_HOWTO_findings: THREE MINIMUM. `stat` renders at 44px accent under a FINDING NN label. `claim` is one explaining line. `where` MUST name the note, page, table or statement — 'the 10-Q' is rejected; '10-Q Note 3, three pages past the highlights' is accepted. ORDER THIS LIST TO DELIVERY ORDER or the breadcrumb kickers lie.

findings.claim: One sentence: the number management leads with, set against the number they file three pages later.
findings.where: 10-Q Note 3 — the revenue-recognition paragraph, three pages past the highlights
10-Q statement of operations, the tax line
arithmetic on the guide they published as a raise

_HOWTO_fairValue: Three cases so the deck can ship a bear/bull bracket, never a single point estimate (Rule 20). The fvband entry line is computed in derive() — e.g. the midpoint of base and bull.
_HOWTO_verdict: `call` is BUY / WATCH / AVOID. `callLine` is the one sentence. Tiles are the scored dimensions; `rating` is strong / mixed / weak.

verdict.callLine: One sentence. No typed figures — use {path|fmt} tokens for anything price-dependent.

_HOWTO_proseLiteralsOK: Structural filing figures that are fixed for the quarter and therefore allowed to appear literally in prose. Every entry is a decision someone made — keep the list short and justified.
_HOWTO_notes: One key per slide id. The long-form presenter script — never rendered on screen, lands in SCRIPT.md and Notes/. Write these properly; they are half the episode. Include the target duration.

notes.findings: COLD OPEN, to camera before the deck: … THEN the slide: … TARGET 26s.
